Hounslow.schoolNote: Several good schools including Lampton and Hounslow Heath. Grammar schools nearby in Slough.
Hounslow.floodNote: Low flood risk across most of the borough. Some risk near Thames at Chiswick.

Hillingdon.schoolNote: Good school provision including several Outstanding primaries. Vyners School well-regarded.

Hillingdon.healthcareNote: Hillingdon Hospital (A&E), Mount Vernon Hospital. Good GP coverage.

Richmond upon Thames.schoolNote: Multiple Outstanding primaries. Strong grammar school presence in neighbouring Kingston.

Richmond upon Thames.aqNote: Generally good air quality. Large green spaces help. Some road pollution along A316.

Ealing.schoolNote: Good schools throughout. Twyford CofE is Outstanding. Ellen Wilkinson school well-regarded.

Ealing.healthcareNote: Ealing Hospital (A&E). Good GP density. Several walk-in centres.

Wandsworth.schoolNote: Some of London's best state schools. Graveney, Burntwood, multiple Outstanding primaries. Major draw for families.

Wandsworth.healthcareNote: St George's Hospital (major A&E and trauma centre). Excellent healthcare provision.

Lambeth.schoolNote: Dunraven School Outstanding. Several good primaries in Streatham and Clapham.
Lambeth.floodNote: Thames flood risk along northern boundary. Parts of Vauxhall and Waterloo in flood zone.

Lambeth.healthcareNote: St Thomas' Hospital and King's College Hospital (both major A&E). Excellent tertiary care.

Lewisham.schoolNote: Prendergast and Haberdashers' well-regarded. Several Outstanding primaries in Blackheath area.

Lewisham.healthcareNote: Lewisham Hospital (A&E). Good GP and pharmacy coverage.

Greenwich.schoolNote: Thomas Tallis well-regarded. Several Outstanding primaries in Blackheath and Eltham.

Greenwich.healthcareNote: Queen Elizabeth Hospital (A&E). Good healthcare provision across the borough.

Tower Hamlets.schoolNote: Mulberry Academy Outstanding. Several strong primaries despite deprivation challenges.

Tower Hamlets.transportNote: DLR, Central, District, Hammersmith, Jubilee, Elizabeth Lines. One of London's best-connected boroughs.
Tower Hamlets.healthcareNote: Royal London Hospital (major trauma centre). Whitechapel medical hub. Excellent GP coverage.
Tower Hamlets.crimeVintage: ONS Table C4, year ending March 2026

Camden.schoolNote: UCL Academy and strong primary provision. Many private school options.
Camden.floodNote: Low flood risk overall. Some surface water risk near Regent's Canal.
Camden.aqNote: Poor air quality along Euston Road, Camden High Street, and major thoroughfares.

Camden.healthcareNote: University College Hospital (UCLH), Royal Free Hospital. World-class tertiary care.
Camden.crimeVintage: ONS Table C4, year ending March 2026

Islington.schoolNote: Highbury Grove and City of London Academy well-regarded. Competitive for primary places.
Islington.floodNote: Low flood risk. Mostly elevated terrain.
Islington.aqNote: Upper Street, Holloway Road are hotspots. Residential streets off main roads are better.
Islington.transportNote: Victoria, Northern, Piccadilly Lines. King's Cross hub nearby. Excellent bus routes.

Hackney.schoolNote: Mossbourne Academy Outstanding. Schools have improved significantly in recent years.

Hackney.transportNote: Overground, National Rail. No tube but excellent bus network. London's best cycling infrastructure.
Hackney.healthcareNote: Homerton University Hospital (A&E). Good GP coverage. Improving services.

Barnet.schoolNote: Queen Elizabeth's Boys' and Henrietta Barnett are top grammar schools. Strong primary provision.
Barnet.floodNote: Low flood risk. Mostly elevated terrain. Some localised risk along Dollis Brook.
Barnet.aqNote: Good air quality in most areas. A1/A41 corridors are worse. Residential areas enjoy clean air.
Barnet.transportNote: Northern Line (High Barnet/Edgware branches). Thameslink serves New Barnet, Oakleigh Park.
Barnet.healthcareNote: Barnet Hospital (A&E), Royal Free Barnet. Good GP coverage in residential areas.
Barnet.crimeVintage: ONS Table C4, year ending March 2026

Croydon.schoolNote: Harris Academy Outstanding. Several strong primaries. Selective schools nearby in Sutton.

Bromley.schoolNote: Grammar school system (Newstead Wood, St Olave's nearby). Strong primary provision throughout.

Bromley.aqNote: One of London's greenest boroughs. Low traffic density in residential areas.

Bromley.healthcareNote: Princess Royal University Hospital (A&E). Good GP coverage.

Newham.schoolNote: Brampton Manor sends many students to Oxbridge. Several new academies improving rapidly.
Newham.floodNote: Royal Docks, Beckton, and areas near Thames in flood zones. Thames Barrier provides protection.

Southwark.schoolNote: Harris Academy group has multiple Outstanding academies. Charter School popular.
Southwark.floodNote: Thames flood risk along northern boundary. Bermondsey, Rotherhithe, Borough in flood zones.
Southwark.aqNote: Old Kent Road, Elephant and Castle are hotspots. Dulwich has much better air quality.

Southwark.healthcareNote: Guy's and St Thomas' Hospital. King's College Hospital. World-class tertiary care.

Hammersmith and Fulham.schoolNote: Lady Margaret, Sacred Heart Outstanding. Strong primary provision throughout.

Brent.schoolNote: Michaela Community School gained national attention. Queens Park Community School is Good.
Brent.floodNote: Low flood risk overall. Some localised risk along River Brent.

Haringey.schoolNote: Fortismere and Highgate Wood strong. Good primaries in the west. East continuing to improve.

Waltham Forest.schoolNote: Holy Family, Walthamstow School for Girls well-regarded. Improving primary provision.
Waltham Forest.floodNote: Low flood risk in most areas. Some risk along River Lea corridor in the west.

Waltham Forest.transportNote: Victoria Line to Walthamstow. Central Line at Leytonstone/Leyton. Overground.
Waltham Forest.healthcareNote: Whipps Cross Hospital (A&E, being rebuilt). Some areas underserved for GPs.
Waltham Forest.crimeVintage: ONS Table C4, year ending March 2026

Merton.schoolNote: Harris Academy Morden Outstanding. Wimbledon area has excellent primaries. Several private options.

Merton.aqNote: A24 and South Wimbledon areas affected. Wimbledon Common has excellent air quality.

Redbridge.schoolNote: Ilford County High is a top grammar school. Several Outstanding primaries. Strong academic culture.

Redbridge.aqNote: A12 corridor is worse. Residential areas in Wanstead and South Woodford are good.

Enfield.schoolNote: Latymer School is a selective grammar. Several Outstanding primaries. Edmonton improving.
Enfield.floodNote: Low flood risk in most areas. Some localised risk along Turkey Brook and Pymmes Brook.
Enfield.aqNote: Good air quality in most areas. A10 corridor is worse. Large green spaces help.
Enfield.transportNote: Piccadilly Line to Arnos Grove/Southgate. Overground to Enfield Town. Some areas car-dependent.

Kingston upon Thames.schoolNote: Tiffin Boys' and Tiffin Girls' are top grammar schools. Multiple Outstanding primaries.

Sutton.schoolNote: Sutton Grammar, Nonsuch, Wilson's are top selective schools. Outstanding primaries throughout. Best state schools in London.
Sutton.floodNote: Low flood risk throughout. Mostly elevated terrain away from major rivers.
Sutton.aqNote: Low traffic density. One of the cleanest boroughs in London for air quality.
Sutton.transportNote: National Rail to London Bridge/Victoria. Tramlink connection. No tube. Some areas car-dependent.

Sutton.crimeVintage: ONS Table C4, year ending March 2026

Westminster.schoolNote: Grey Coat Hospital Outstanding. Very competitive for school places due to small residential population.
Westminster.floodNote: Thames flood risk along Embankment and Pimlico. Good flood defences in place.
Westminster.aqNote: Oxford Street, Park Lane have some of London's worst pollution. Side streets and parks are better.

Barking.schoolNote: Sydney Russell Academy improved. Jo Richardson Community School is popular. Some primaries Outstanding.
Barking.floodNote: Barking Riverside and Thames-side areas have flood risk. Inland areas are generally safe.

Havering.schoolNote: Several Outstanding primaries. Coopers' Company school well-regarded. Grammar schools nearby in Essex.

Havering.aqNote: Good air quality in most residential areas. A12/A13 corridors are worse.

Bexley.schoolNote: Townley Grammar and Bexley Grammar are selective. Several good primaries across the borough.
Bexley.floodNote: Thames-side areas (Erith, Thamesmead) have significant flood risk. Inland areas are safe.
Bexley.aqNote: Good air quality across most of the borough. Lower traffic density than inner boroughs.

Bexley.crimeVintage: ONS Table C4, year ending March 2026

Harrow.schoolNote: Harrow School (private, historic). Nower Hill High School is popular. Several Outstanding primaries.
Harrow.floodNote: Low flood risk throughout. Mostly elevated terrain.
Harrow.aqNote: Good air quality in residential areas. Main roads through Harrow town centre are worse.
Harrow.transportNote: Metropolitan Line (fast to Baker Street). Bakerloo to Harrow & Wealdstone. Good bus network.

Harrow.crimeVintage: ONS Table C4, year ending March 2026

Queens.floodNote: Severe flood risk in southern coastal areas (Rockaway, Howard Beach). Hurricane Sandy caused major damage.
Queens.aqNote: Airport operations and highway traffic affect air quality. Residential areas away from highways are better.
Queens.transportNote: 7 train, E/F/M/R, LIRR, JFK AirTrain. Flushing is a major hub.
Queens.healthcareNote: Queens Hospital Center, Long Island Jewish Medical Center, NYC Health+Hospitals.

Brooklyn.schoolNote: Brooklyn Tech is a top specialized high school. Strong charter school options. PS/IS networks improving.
Brooklyn.floodNote: Coastal areas (Red Hook, Coney Island, Brighton Beach) have significant flood risk. Interior areas are generally safe.

Bronx.schoolNote: Bronx Science is a top specialized school. Multiple charter school options. School quality varies significantly by neighbourhood.

Staten Island.floodNote: Eastern and southern shores have severe flood risk. Hurricane Sandy devastated many areas.
Staten Island.aqNote: Best air quality of any NYC borough. Lower traffic density. More green space.

Staten Island.healthcareNote: Staten Island University Hospital. Limited compared to other boroughs.
